LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_RenameStand_Desc: Set a custom display name for this outfit stand.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_ApparelPolicySync: Choose apparel policies whose allowed apparel should live-sync into this stand's apparel filter. Multiple policies are combined by union.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_AllowAddingItems_: If disabled, colonists will not haul items to this stand.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_ReturnToStandGizm: Order a colonist to return their outfit to the stand, according to its storage settings. The colonist will try to wear all apparel not accepted by the stand.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_RareTicksPerMendM: Mending stands restore 1 point of durability to a contained item once per this many rare ticks.\nOne in-game hour is equal to 10 rare ticks.\nReload the save for changes to take effect.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_EquipSpeedFactor_: Modifies speed with which pawns equip/transfer items to stands. 100 = normal speed, 0 = instant.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_RemoveInteraction: If enabled, mechanized, mending and tailor's racks will not have interaction spots in front of them, just like vanilla outfit stands. Requires a game restart.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_RemoveMechanizedS: If enabled, mechanized outfit stands and their research project will be removed from the game. Requires a game restart.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_RemoveMendingStan: If enabled, mending outfit stands and their research project will be removed from the game. Requires a game restart.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_RemoveTailorStand: If enabled, tailor's outfit stands will be removed from the game. Requires a game restart.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_TailorMendStart_T: Colonists only start mending clothes on a tailor's stand when an item is below this percentage of its hit points. Always kept below the "mend up to" value. Only applies to tailor's stands.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_TailorMendLimit_T: Mending on a tailor's stand stops once an item reaches this percentage of its hit points. A manual "Mend clothes" order also stops here. Only applies to tailor's stands; mending stands are not affected.
LanguageData.OutfitStandsPlusForked_TailorMending_Des: If enabled, colonists who do tailoring will mend the cloth and leather clothes on this stand once they drop below {0}% of their hit points, up to {1}%. Mending costs one cloth or leather per 10 hit points. Turn it off to keep this stand for display or storage only; a manual "Mend clothes" order still works.
